description: This file contains helper functions for ASN.1 encoding/decoding related to 3GPP F1AP protocol, including conversions between ASN.1 structures and internal representations, handling of cause codes, cell IDs, QoS parameters, and SRS configuration.

methods.name: asn1_to_cause
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 cause_c structure to internal f1ap_cause_t type.

methods.name: cause_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts internal f1ap_cause_t type to ASN.1 cause_c structure.

methods.name: cgi_from_asn1
methods.description: Extracts NR cell global ID from ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: cgi_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts NR cell global ID to ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: nr_cell_id_from_asn1
methods.description: Creates NR cell identity from ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: trp_info_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts DU TRP info to ASN.1 format.

methods.name: from_asn1
methods.description: Converts ASN.1 SRS configuration to internal representation.
